title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-020
doc_notes: This document is a collection of source files and articles regarding the JAL 1628 UAP incident, including FAA internal memos, analysis of radar data, and press coverage.

incidents.summary: Japan Airlines flight 1628 reported being shadowed by two unidentified objects for approximately 50 minutes over Alaska.
incidents.explanation: FAA attributed radar returns to uncorrelated primary and beacon targets (split images) and visual sightings to potential misidentification or atmospheric phenomena.
incidents.quote: For nearly an hour, a huge, unrecognizable something, performing amazing maneuvers, followed JAL Flight No. 1628 over Alaska
incidents.shape: globular with a lip around the middle

incidents.summary: Teenagers in Anchorage launched homemade light-balloons made of dry cleaner bags and candles, causing public confusion.
incidents.explanation: Identified as homemade contraptions using dry cleaner bags, cardboard, and candles.
incidents.quote: The teenagers would send up six of these over half a mile, confounding the adults with manufactured lightballs.

incidents.summary: Capt. Terauchi reported seeing unusual lights while flying near Arctic Village.
incidents.explanation: Town lights distorted by ice crystals created by a temperature inversion.
incidents.quote: Capt. Terauchi again reported seeing unusual lights while flying over Alaska.
